_readme: See bank_status.README.md. Data, not logic: 'state' may only be review_required | coming_soon | unsupported (verified/legacy are derived from the serve configuration). 'reason' is shown verbatim in the UI for greyed-out or review-flagged banks — keep it one plain sentence.

iob.reason: IOB statements print no opening/closing balance anchors, so reports can never be independently verified — every report is marked needs review.

south_indian.reason: South Indian Bank statements print no opening/closing balance anchors, so reports can never be independently verified — every report is marked needs review.

apgv.reason: AP Grameena Vikas statements print no opening/closing balance anchors, so reports can never be independently verified — every report is marked needs review.

bandhan.reason: Bandhan's statement layout needs engine work that is not scheduled yet.

dcb.reason: DCB's statement layout needs engine work that is not scheduled yet.

pnb.reason: Punjab National statements print no opening/closing balance anchors, so reports can never be independently verified — every report is marked needs review.

indusind.reason: Measured on samples but held back: the independent verification gate is not passed yet.

kvb.reason: Most Karur Vysya samples store digits as image data that cannot be read, so only a subset can be supported.

dhanlaxmi.reason: Rows are read and totals reconcile, but the corpus lacks printed balance anchors, so output is always labelled needs-review.

csb.reason: Several CSB layouts read correctly but a share of samples carry no bank markers, so coverage is partial.

deutsche.reason: Too few readable sample statements on file to build a verified layout.

fino_pb.reason: Only one readable sample statement on file; nothing to validate a layout against.

tmb.reason: Too few readable sample statements on file to build a layout.

rbl.reason: No statement layout or parser has been built for RBL yet.

sbm.reason: No statement layout or parser has been built for SBM yet.
